examples.heading: The President’s letter removing Governor Cook
examples.before: The American people must be able to have full confidence in the honesty of the members entrusted with setting policy and overseeing the Federal Reserve. In light of your deceitful and potentially criminal conduct in a financial matter, they cannot and I do not have such confidence in your integrity.
examples.quote: At a minimum, the conduct at issue exhibits the sort of gross negligence in financial transactions that calls into question your competence and trustworthiness as a financial regulator.
examples.source: As quoted by the district court, Appendix to Application, p. 29a

compare.title: National Labor Relations Act
compare.text: Any member of the Board may be removed by the President, <mark>upon notice and hearing</mark>, for neglect of duty or malfeasance in office, but for no other cause.

glossary.expansion: inefficiency, neglect of duty, or malfeasance in office

examples.text: A standard list of grounds for removing an officer, e.g. for members of the Federal Trade Commission (15 U.S.C. § 41). The Federal Reserve Act says only “for cause”.
